content:
The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
The process successfully passed 5 of 6 tests, including basic file generation, but failed test_word_summary_content in /tests/test_outputs.py. The verifier returned 'AssertionError: Word summary must mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations' with 'assert 0 >= 2'. Ensure the docx output includes specific facility-session IDs (e.g., 'FAC-SESS') derived from the top session totals in the source data.
